task.description:
Implement SCH-01 durable timer creation exactly as designed in src/design/scheduler.md.

Implementation requirements:
- Add scheduler persistence module(s) and typed error sets needed for durable timer writes.
- Ensure when execution reaches timer node, a durable timer record is persisted with timer_id, instance_id, fire_at UTC, status=PENDING, payload.
- Enforce DB-03 atomicity: transition/state persistence and timer insert in the same transaction.
- Preserve pure-function rule in src/engine/transition.zig (no I/O).
- Handle edge case: reject timer creation for terminal CANCELLED instance.
- Preserve semantics for fire_at <= NOW() (timer is persisted as PENDING and due on next SCH-02 poll).
- Apply any additive/constraint-hardening migration changes required by design.

Validation requirements:
- zig build exits 0
- zig build test exits 0
- zig build migrate exits 0

Security and correctness constraints:
- No SQL string interpolation; use parameterized queries only.
- No secrets in source.
- No catch unreachable on realistic failure paths.
- Keep changes focused and aligned with SCH-01 scope.
acceptance_criteria: SCH-01 behavior implemented in backend code with typed errors
Durable timer creation occurs atomically with transition/state write
Any required migration updates are present and non-destructive
zig build, zig build test, zig build migrate all succeed

result.summary: Implemented SCH-01 durable timer creation by emitting timer-create transition effects on TIMER node entry and persisting timers atomically within instance transition transactions, including cancelled-instance rejection and additive timer status constraint hardening migration.
